# Parichay

> Parichay is a client-only manual studio for creating private personal and professional manuals. Nothing is stored on a server, uploaded, tracked, or tied to an account.

Parichay helps people write the context that is often left unspoken, choose which answers are included, private, or omitted, and shape the result into a manual they can keep, print, or share.

## Core Details

- Product: Privacy-first personal manual studio
- Tagline: Your Story, Always Ready.
- Storage: Client-side only
- Accounts: None
- Database: None
- Analytics: None
- Pricing: Free
- Primary modes: Me Manual and Work Manual

## Visibility Rules

- Included answers may appear in share links, QR codes, image exports, and PDFs.
- Private answers stay local unless the user chooses a private local export or print.
- Omitted answers are left out of previews, shares, and exports.
- Shared URLs contain only included answers.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://parichay-your-story.vercel.app/
- How it works: https://parichay-your-story.vercel.app/how-it-works
- Privacy: https://parichay-your-story.vercel.app/privacy

## Good Summary

Parichay is a private, client-only web app for creating personal and professional operating manuals. It has no accounts, database, uploads, or analytics. Users control answer visibility and can share only the parts they mark included.
